name: mic-frequency-response
description: Digitize microphone frequency-response charts into a CSV database. Ships (1) the digitize-frequency-response + digitize-polar-pattern skills — find a mic's official FR chart, AI-read or pixel-trace charts into CSV (frequency response: freq_hz,level_db; polar pattern: angle_deg,level_db), and ingest into data/<brand>-<model>/; (2) a zero-dependency web Digitizer (semi-automatic pixel tracing, node:test-covered). Facts-only: original images are never committed, only the derived data + source URL.
